description: Synthetic dataset for studying attenuation mechanisms in gas-liquid stratified flows
research_topic: Study on the Attenuation Mechanisms in Stratified Flows: Beyond Single Phase Leakage Acoustics

flow_regime_characterization.csv.description: Flow regime parameters including void fraction, velocities, and flow patterns

acoustic_attenuation_data.csv.description: Acoustic attenuation coefficients, transmission loss, and SNR data

acoustic_timeseries_data.json.description: Time-series acoustic pressure data for selected experiments
acoustic_timeseries_data.json.format: JSON with arrays of time, source, and received signals

turbulence_shear_data.csv.description: Turbulence statistics and shear stress measurements

velocity_profiles.csv.description: Velocity profiles across pipe diameter for both phases

physical_models.void_fraction: Drift flux model with slip correction

data_quality.physical_basis: Based on established correlations and models from literature
data_quality.uncertainty: Random variations added to simulate measurement uncertainty (~10%)
data_quality.validation: Recommended to validate against experimental data when available

suitable_for: Model training for machine learning applications
limitations: Synthetic data may not capture all physical complexities
Should be validated against real experimental data
Simplified models used for some phenomena

references: Taitel, Y., & Dukler, A. E. (1976). A model for predicting flow regime transitions
Wood, A. B. (1930). A Textbook of Sound
Brennen, C. E. (2005). Fundamentals of Multiphase Flow
Prosperetti, A. (2015). Linear pressure waves in bubbly liquids
